examples.claim: No receiver ACK is shown in this record.
examples.allowed: Receipt state is unknown in the inspected record.
examples.blocked: Therefore nobody received it, nobody read it, or nobody will.
examples.evidence: One selected publication record; no receiver-origin readproof bound.

examples.claim: A bounded search did not show this page.
examples.allowed: The chosen query did not return it at this observation time.
examples.blocked: Therefore the page does not exist anywhere or is being suppressed.
examples.evidence: Search terms and coverage would need an independent dated record.

examples.claim: No task was present in a fully enumerated test queue.
examples.allowed: No task was present within the sampled queue scope at the specified observation.
examples.blocked: Therefore no tasks exist globally, before or after the sample.
examples.evidence: Synthetic queue Q-demo, explicit finite coverage=complete, one dated inspection, method=list-all.

examples.claim: An expected manifest was not found.
examples.allowed: The expected path was missing from the verified bounded inventory.
examples.blocked: Therefore the manifest was never created or was intentionally hidden.
examples.evidence: Synthetic expected-file manifest and observed local path scan.

examples.claim: Native CoOrbWare runtime has not been established.
examples.allowed: This is a candidate not qualified as an installed native runtime.
examples.blocked: Therefore it cannot exist later, or a JSON projection is a running OS.
examples.evidence: Source-linked public prototype plus explicit runtime-held field.

examples.claim: A proposed future substrate might render more dimensions.
examples.allowed: An idea is available for testable evaluation.
examples.blocked: Therefore the substrate exists or has exotic physical properties.
examples.evidence: Explicitly hypothetical example; no device, physics measurement or provider acceptance.

examples.claim: Two explicitly supplied witnesses disagree about one claim.
examples.allowed: The evidence contains both support and opposition; preserve the conflict.
examples.blocked: Choose either side as settled, or infer any unrelated conclusion.
examples.evidence: Synthetic witness A supports, synthetic witness B opposes the same scoped claim.

examples.claim: What is the colour of a virtual session ID?
examples.allowed: Colour is not a defined property of an identifier under this model.
examples.blocked: Its colour is hidden, absent, or forbidden.
examples.evidence: Schema defines IDs as opaque strings; appearance belongs to a renderer.

examples.claim: A candidate worker does not have permission to send emails.
examples.allowed: The authority envelope excludes outbound sending.
examples.blocked: Email delivery is physically impossible or everyone rejected the message.
examples.evidence: Synthetic read-only authority envelope; no send adapter granted.

examples.claim: An object is not shown on this public surface.
examples.allowed: The public view withholds information under a privacy rule.
examples.blocked: No object exists, or the private contents can be inferred from a placeholder.
examples.evidence: Privacy class is restricted; original content deliberately absent from this demo.

examples.claim: A retired task identity has no automatic wake authority.
examples.allowed: A historical task may be preserved while effect permission remains ended.
examples.evidence: Synthetic retirement declaration and no reactivation grant.

examples.claim: An exact source is not recoverable from the documented backups.
examples.allowed: The stated recovery method cannot restore it within the tested boundary.
examples.blocked: It is metaphysically impossible for any other copy to exist.
examples.evidence: Synthetic lost-file scenario with explicitly bounded backup coverage.

examples.claim: A single integer is both even and odd under standard parity definitions.
examples.allowed: This conjunction is inconsistent under the declared integer/parity axioms.
examples.blocked: Every speculative physical or metaphysical possibility is disproven.
examples.evidence: Declared definitions of integer, even, odd and elementary derivation, not an empirical universal.
